messages:
alejandro: Quick PSA — temporary hold on the release train due to a spike in GPU node evictions in us-west. Estimated pause ~36h, will update earlier if infra stabilizes. Please hold non-urgent submissions for 2h. :warning:

deploy-bot: [automated] canary-health: 12/48 canaries degraded in us-west. Dashboard: https://internal.ops/canary-dashboard

samira: If a team has a P0 customer hotfix, what's the exception flow?

alejandro: @samira — open a ticket on the release-train board with label `release-exception` and ping me + @ops-oncall. Exceptions limited to P0 hotfixes; we'll triage within 30m.

linda: For teams using Dedicated pools, will reserved capacity be affected?

ops-oncall: Dedicated pools not impacted by the eviction events, but autoscaler rebalancing may shift background capacity. Teams with strict SLAs should escalate to #infra-allocations. :eyes:

matt: This will likely push the hotfix window. Suggest moving non-critical PRs to the next slot. :arrow_right:

alejandro: Rebalance plan: non-pinned canaries will be reassigned to eu-west and apac-regional to keep validation moving. To keep a canary in us-west, add a comment to the canary ticket `infra:pin=us-west`.

deploy-bot: Command to check canary status by team/region:
```
rictl canary status --team=<team> --region=eu-west
```

alejandro: Owners of reassigned canaries will get automated DMs. I'll post a status update in ~3h with progress. Thanks for the quick responses — please surface urgent blockers here. :thumbsup:
